visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a Frieza action figure with purple and white details. Behind it, a man with a black cap and beard looks into the camera. The background is a plain white wall with studio lighting. (2) The man holds a plastic cup filled with a green slushy liquid and a striped straw. He wears a brown utility uniform and a large black wristwatch. (3) Wide shot of the man sitting on a pale green sofa. He holds the drink while pointing at the Frieza figure placed on a small wooden side table. A large modern abstract painting hangs on the wall behind him. (4) Extreme close-up of green liquid being poured from the straw onto the light green fabric of the sofa cushion. The liquid pools on the surface without soaking in. (5) Low-angle shot showing the man's arm pushing a large black and green professional toolbox into the clearance space beneath the sofa. The floor is a speckled gray terrazzo. (6) A white circular robot vacuum cleaner moves smoothly under the sofa, demonstrating the leg height and clearance. (7) The man uses a bright yellow microfiber cloth to wipe the liquid from the sofa cushion. The fabric appears completely dry and clean immediately after the wipe. (8) The man leans back and lies down on the sofa, then sits upright to demonstrate the seat depth and firm support of the cushions. (9) A second man wearing a black cap and glasses enters the frame from the right, excitedly grabs the Frieza figure, and walks away while the first man watches him. (10) A final static shot shows the empty three-seater green sofa in a brightly lit studio environment with white walls.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Slim Bean Sofa' by Sleepy Tofu using humor and puns. The host uses a Frieza figurine to play on linguistic similarities between the character's name, green bean paste, and the sofa's model name, effectively showcasing features like easy-cleaning fabric, storage space, and senior-friendly support.
